segments.source: The fifth-generation E8 NAD moves beyond familiar hot recipes with Light and Sweet specialties, while retaining side-button selection around its color display. Its twenty-seven-drink menu is most relevant to people who will use those preparation styles, rather than treat the count itself as an upgrade. The automatic milk hose and closed brew system also make JURA's cleaning routine part of the purchase. Connectivity is optional on this North American generation. Compare the exact NAD machine with the E6 around drink preferences and the E8's additional preparation options; older E8 reviews cannot establish all of this generation's features.
